test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In January 2019, which organisation developed a mobile facility to help provide immediate relief in case of any attack involving radioactive material?
solution:
The correct answer is __**DRDO**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **DRDO**

 
 
• DRDO is a military research and development wing of the Ministry of Defence, headquarters in New Delhi, India.
 
• It was founded in 1958.
 
• It has the vision to empower India with cutting-edge defence technologies and a mission to achieve self-reliance in critical defence technologies and systems.
 
• DRDO has developed an antibody detection-based kit called DIPCOVAN.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **TIFR**

 
 
• The Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR), located in Mumbai, is a premier institution in India dedicated to research in the fields of natural sciences, mathematics, and theoretical computer science.
 
• Founded in 1945 by the visionary industrialist J.R.D. Tata, at the behest of the scientific luminary Dr. Homi J. Bhabha, TIFR stands as a testament to India’s commitment to advancing the frontiers of science and technology.
 
• Mumbai, being India's financial and research hub, offers an ideal backdrop for TIFR, facilitating collaboration with other research institutions and industries.
 
• The institute's main campus in Mumbai is pivotal for groundbreaking research and development in fundamental sciences.
 
 
 
• **UCIL**
 
 
• UCIL is associated with Nuclear Power generation.
 
• The Uranium Corporation of India Limited is abbreviated as UCIL.
 
• It is a Public Sector Enterprise, incorporated on 4 October 1967 and is under the Department of Atomic Energy.
 
• It plays a significant role in Nuclear Power Generation by fulfilling the requirement of Uranium for the Pressurized Heavy Water Reactors.
 
• Uranium is the raw material for the nuclear reactors.
 
• The company operates 6 underground mines, 1 open-pit mine, and 2 process plants in the state of Jharkhand.
 
• It also has 1 underground mine and 1 process plant in Andhra Pradesh.
 
• The company will set up new mines in Karnataka, Telangana, and Meghalaya.
 
• CISF is the Central Industrial Security Force that provides security to industrial units, sensitive governmental buildings, the Delhi metro, and airports.
 
• IITM, the Indian Institute of Tropical Meteorology based in Pune, work towards the expansion of research in the tropical Indian Ocean, of the tropics in general with special reference to monsoon meteorology, and air-sea interaction of Indian monsoon. 
 
• ECI is the Electronics Corporation of India and was established in the year 1967 with an aim to create a strong indigenous base in electronics. It is in Hyderabad.
 
 
 
• **BARC**
 
 
• Bhabha Atomic Research Center is the full form of BARC.
 
• BARC is India's premier nuclear research facility headquartered in Trombay, Mumbai, Maharashtra.
 
• It is a multi-disciplinary research center with extensive infrastructure for advanced research and development in nuclear science, engineering, and related areas.
 
• The center is named after Dr. Homi J. Bhabha, who is considered the father of the Indian nuclear program.
 
• Dr. Homi J. Bhabha established the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research (TIFR) in 1945 and later the Atomic Energy Establishment, Trombay (AEET) in 1954, which was renamed BARC in 1966 after his demise.
 
• BARC plays a crucial role in India's nuclear power generation, isotope production, and radiation technology applications.
 
• The center also conducts research in areas such as high-energy physics, plasma physics, material science, and environmental science.
 
• BARC operates under the Department of Atomic Energy (DAE), Government of India.
